purpose: Fill thin permanent Invention + Archaeology unlock coverage: Asgarnia Invention Guild machines as named infrastructure, gizmo shells, charge-pack research ladder, Ancient Invention blueprints; Misthalin Archaeology Guildmaster / screening / research / collectors / material manuals / mattock precision; skilling monolith relics with dig-site regions. Does not re-emit already-indexed ids.

policy.region_rule: region_hint marks where the unlock or activity lives in the current planner taxonomy. region_hints marks a cross-region chain. required_regions is only used when both regions are needed for a full stack. Quest auto-completion and League-specific overrides must be applied separately.
policy.no_trade_rule: Prioritise permanent tools, shop upgrades, machines, blueprints, relic powers, and infrastructure that change self-sufficient skilling throughput. Invention combat perks are intentionally out of scope.
policy.rate_rule: Do not promote stale XP/hour figures. Training rates belong in training datasets; this file records unlock state and effects.
policy.id_policy: New ids only. Skip duplicates of asgarnia:invention-guild, cross-region:invention-machines-guild, anachronia:always-adze-relic, anachronia:death-note-relic, anachronia:bait-and-switch-relic, misthalin:archaeology-guild-shop, misthalin:archaeology-campus-hub, cross-region:mattock-of-time-and-space, havenhythe:tear-of-inanna-hungry-like-the-wolf, and related equipment chains already indexed.

activity_additions.name: Auto disassembler / mk. II (Invention Guild machine)

requirements: Invention unlocked and machine tutorial available at 60 Invention
Simple generator built in the Guild (60 Invention)

Mk. II: 60 items/hour, 40 power, 230 machine charge/hour, capacity 13,000

Armour gizmo blueprint at 16 Invention

activity_additions.name: Charge pack + maximum charge + charge drain reduction
requirements: Charge pack built in Invention tutorial and added to tool belt
Maximum charge improvement research ranks at Invention 22 / 40 / 64 / 87 / 95
Charge drain reduction research ranks at Invention 34 through 105 (nine ranks)
unlocks: Universal charge pool for augmented equipment and skilling tools
Divine charge adds 3,000 charge to the pack (and 3,000 machine charge to the Guild generator)
Max pack capacity ladder: 200k base → 250k / 300k / 350k / 400k / 500k at rank 5
Charge drain reduction up to 20% at rank 9 (105 Invention research)
Without charge: perks inactive, most augmented gear falls to tier-1 stats, no item XP
activity_additions.notes: Permanent account infrastructure, not a consumable. Divine energy → divine charge is the refill loop (Divination multi-region). Machine generators share the same divine-charge currency as the pack.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Charge-pack research is global Invention progression. Energy supply is multi-region Divination.
